title: useReportWebVitals - useReportWebVitals
text_content:
The `` object passed as the hook's argument consists of a number of properties:
``: Unique identifier for the metric in the context of the current page load
``: The name of the performance metric. Possible values include names of [#web-vitals](#web-vitals) metrics (TTFB, FCP, LCP, FID, CLS) specific to a web application.
``: The difference between the current value and the previous value of the metric. The value is typically in milliseconds and represents the change in the metric's value over time.
``: An array of [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/PerformanceEntry](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/PerformanceEntry) associated with the metric. These entries provide detailed information about the performance events related to the metric.
``: Indicates the [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/PerformanceNavigationTiming/type](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/PerformanceNavigationTiming/type) that triggered the metric collection. Possible values include ``, ``, ``, and ``.
``: A qualitative rating of the metric value, providing an assessment of the performance. Possible values are ``, ``, and ``. The rating is typically determined by comparing the metric value against predefined thresholds that indicate acceptable or suboptimal performance.
``: The actual value or duration of the performance entry, typically in milliseconds. The value provides a quantitative measure of the performance aspect being tracked by the metric. The source of the value depends on the specific metric being measured and can come from various [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Performance_API](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Performance_API)s.
